title: Caminandes: Llamigos
summary: A llama and a penguin squabble over the last berry of winter.
description:
The third Caminandes short (2016): in a snowy, stylised Patagonia, Koro the llama meets Oti the penguin and the two fight over a single berry before working out that they get further together.

Creative Commons demonstration media; not a Monumental Original.
